name: Review Engine
who: Local businesses with a physical service and happy customers who never get asked — trades, clinics, salons, garages, restaurants, single or multi-location.
problem: "Our customers love us. We've got eleven Google reviews and the chain down the road has four hundred. I always mean to ask, and then the job is finished and I've moved on."
solution: We make the asking automatic. After every completed job the customer gets a message with a one-tap review link, timed for when they are still pleased. QR cards for the counter and the van. Every review that arrives gets a reply drafted for approval, good or bad, and a monthly count of what moved.
promise: Your customers are happy and your Google listing does not show it. A steady flow of new reviews every month, without anyone in your business having to ask for one.
gets:
An automatic post-job review request by SMS or email, with a one-tap link
QR cards for the counter, the van and the invoice
A drafted reply to every review within a day, and a monthly report of what came in
positioning: Nearly free to deliver, impossible to argue with, and the results are public — the client can see the product working on their own Google listing.
voice: Light and practical. Talks about the number of reviews and what customers said, not about reputation management.
channels: Bolt-on to every existing web client, local business groups, Google Business Profile audits as the opener
